_meta.description: Grouped Process aggregating revenue by month decorated with TWO overlay layers — OVERLAY_DELTA_VS_BASELINE and OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_BASELINE — both anchored on the same fixed positional baseline (Ref.BaselineIndex.Position=0, the first month). DELTA emits (point - baseline) per group (absolute subtractive difference in revenue units). INDEX emits (point / baseline * 100) per group (multiplicative ratio scaled to 100). Sibling shapes — DELTA is additive twin, INDEX is the ratio twin; together they form the canonical positional-anchor comparison pair. Both windowed-Process kinds consume the Ref.BaselineIndex.Position arm. Buffered (the baseline resolver reads host.ValueAt after finalize). Out-of-range Position fires PULSE_OVERLAY_REF_UNKNOWN. INDEX emits PULSE_OVERLAY_REF_ZERO on zero baseline; DELTA does not (subtraction by zero is well-defined). Renderers centre INDEX colour ramps on baseline = 100, DELTA on baseline = 0.
_meta.name: process-delta-index-vs-baseline
